description:
When your chill and don’t put the “good girl” expectation on women

You’d be surprised what they tell you

You’re either on the “in crowd” of this

Or you’re lost in Disney fairytale land

Much better to see the stark reality and stop judging human nature

Than to think our hardwiring isn’t influencing our decisions when it comes to raw attraction

Sure she might consciously SAY one thing

But ideals don’t trump human nature

And the truth is found in actions not words

Simple as that
transcript: Women have two categories for the guys that they're seeing there's the placeholder guy and then there's the guy that they have genuine desire for now Unfortunately, most guys fall into placeholder category, which means they date she's you know, they're technically, she's his girlfriend, but It's more so that she couldn't lock down the guy that she had genuine attraction for. So oftentimes what happens is the placeholder guy will get devastated because he didn't realize that he wasn't sparking genuine attraction for her. He was just nice company. He was free attention. He was easy validation, right? And when genuine desire guy came back around, she switched very quickly. So you have to like be aware of these things, right? This is just built in hardwiring. Women are going to go for genuine attraction, but they'll hold on to easy attention if it's there, right? Until they can get to genuine desire. So you have to turn yourself into genuine desire guy, which again comes down to self-belief, complete conviction in yourself, going for what you want, living life on your terms, right? You gotta stop supplicating and just being like, oh, I just need her in my life. You're putting yourself into placeholder category, which never turns out well. You have to live life on your terms.
